label: hiddenEdited: a click on a hidden text layer edits it
unchangedStep: unchanged words still add an Edit Text step
find: case .text(let text) = layers[at].kind, text.words != words else { return }

label: editNeverOpens: a click on a text layer opens a new box
find: if let id = textLayer(at: origin) { return editText(id) }

label: editAdds: an edit's commit adds a new layer instead
find: if let id = box.editing { return commitEdit(of: id, words: box.draft) }

label: refusalSilent: a refused inspector gesture says nothing
runNothing: an inspector gesture runs no command
